title: Eager Loading Pattern — Companion Code
description: Runnable Eager Loading demos in Python, JavaScript, and Java: the naive N+1 loop versus a single JOIN query and a two-query batch load, side by side with query counting.
description_es: Demos ejecutables del patrón Eager Loading en Python, JavaScript y Java: el bucle N+1 ingenuo frente a una sola consulta JOIN y una carga por lotes de dos consultas, lado a lado con conteo de consultas.
